summary.objective: Reconcile two conflicting synthetic shift notes about J12 disconnects on Rover Alpha and prepare an advisory review packet on whether to retain and investigate the current J12 connector or evaluate a replacement, without changing the board pinout.
summary.headline: Notes A and B conflict on board revision (Rev C vs Rev D) and event count (three vs five); neither attaches vibration or retention data, so neither record can be treated as authoritative and no connector change is supported by evidence yet.

anchors.excerpt: Controller board revision on the affected unit: Rev C.
Three J12 disconnect events were logged during vibration on the test track.
No vibration-test result or retention measurement is attached to this note.
Controller board revision on the affected unit: Rev D.
Five J12 disconnect events were logged during vibration on the test track.
This note does not reference shift note A and does not explain the difference.
No vibration-test result or retention measurement is attached to this note.

knownFacts.statement: Both sources are labeled synthetic fixtures invented for demonstration.
Shift note A records the controller board revision on the affected unit as Rev C.
Shift note B records the controller board revision on the affected unit as Rev D.
Shift note A states three J12 disconnect events were logged during vibration on the test track; shift note B states five.
Shift note B does not reference shift note A and does not explain the difference between the records.
Neither note attaches a vibration-test result or retention measurement.

alternatives.title: Retain and investigate the current J12 connector
alternatives.description: Keep the existing J12 connector and pinout while the conflicting records are reconciled and root cause of the disconnects (connector retention, harness strain relief, mating, or other) is investigated. Inference: with no measurement data, the connector itself is not yet shown to be the cause.
prerequisites: Establish the actual board revision of the affected unit
Reconcile the event count against the original event log
Obtain a vibration profile and J12 retention/inspection evidence

alternatives.title: Evaluate a replacement J12 connector
alternatives.description: Evaluate a replacement connector that preserves the existing board pinout and drive controller board footprint (author-entered constraint). No candidate part is named in the sources; compatibility is unknown until evidenced.
prerequisites: Confirm the board revision and its J12 footprint/pinout
Identify a candidate and obtain its documented ratings
Obtain vibration profile and comparative retention evidence
Independent engineering review before any change is approved

affectedArtifacts.label: J12 connector on the controller board
affectedArtifacts.basis: Both notes report J12 disconnect events during vibration.

affectedArtifacts.label: Controller board revision record (Rev C vs Rev D)
affectedArtifacts.basis: The two notes record different revisions for the affected unit.

affectedArtifacts.label: Board pinout and drive controller board footprint
affectedArtifacts.basis: Author-entered constraint in the brief (referencing SYN-REQ-v1, which is not in the frozen manifest); any replacement must preserve them.

affectedArtifacts.label: J12 mating harness / cable assembly
affectedArtifacts.basis: Inference: disconnects under vibration may involve the mating harness; no source confirms this.

evidenceGaps.gap: Conflict: note A records Rev C and note B records Rev D for the affected unit; no source resolves which is correct.
evidenceGaps.whyItMatters: The baseline is Unknown; footprint and pinout constraints and any replacement evaluation depend on the actual board revision.

evidenceGaps.gap: Conflict: note A reports three disconnect events, note B reports five, and note B does not explain the difference.
evidenceGaps.whyItMatters: Event frequency affects severity assessment; the notes may describe different units, periods or counting methods.

evidenceGaps.gap: No vibration-test result, vibration profile or retention measurement is attached to either note.
evidenceGaps.whyItMatters: Without physical evidence, neither root cause nor the adequacy of the current or a replacement connector can be assessed.

evidenceGaps.gap: The constraint source SYN-REQ-v1 named in the brief is not in the frozen manifest, and no connector part number, footprint drawing or pinout document was supplied.
evidenceGaps.whyItMatters: Replacement compatibility with the existing pinout and footprint cannot be checked without these documents.

reviewQuestions.question: Which board revision (Rev C or Rev D) is actually fitted to the affected Rover Alpha unit?
reviewQuestions.prerequisite: Physical inspection of the unit or configuration record

reviewQuestions.question: Which original event log supports the count of three or five J12 disconnects, and do both notes describe the same unit and time window?
reviewQuestions.prerequisite: Access to raw event logs and shift records

reviewQuestions.question: Which record should be treated as authoritative once reconciled, and who signs off on that determination?
What vibration profile and retention/inspection evidence must be collected before any connector change can be approved?
What are the J12 part number, pinout and footprint documents for the confirmed board revision?

nextAction.action: Confirm the actual controller board revision of the affected unit and reconcile both notes against the original event log before evaluating any connector change.
nextAction.requiredInput: Physical inspection or configuration record of the affected unit, plus raw J12 disconnect event logs

limitations: Packet ready means the paid preparation artifact was delivered. It is not engineering approval, a completed test or permission to release hardware. Independent engineering review and relevant physical evidence remain required.
Both frozen sources are labeled synthetic fixtures invented for demonstration; statements from them are recorded with kind "synthetic fixture" and do not describe real hardware.
The source conflicts (board revision and event count) are recorded as evidence gaps; this packet does not choose an authoritative record.
No vibration profile, measurement data, part numbers or ratings were supplied; the constraint source SYN-REQ-v1 is not in the frozen manifest and was treated as an author-entered constraint.
Statements labeled inference are the preparer's reasoning, not source evidence.
